entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. I... I think I need to return something? I'm a bit lost. I bought a jersey a while ago, and the website is so confusing. I don't know what I'm supposed to do.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
I guess it's a preference? It's just the wrong size. I finally got around to trying it on for a ride and it's much too tight. I really don't understand the sizing charts you have online.
I understand, getting the perfect fit can sometimes be a challenge. Could you please provide me with your order number?
Um, okay, let me find the email... It's all so overwhelming. Here it is. VF982-1145-B. I think that's it.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series Cycling Jersey, delivered on November 23rd, 2025. That was 59 days ago. You were looking to exchange it?
Yes, an exchange would be wonderful, if that's possible. I'm just so worried I waited too long. The policies are so hard to follow. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. Let me just check the policy for you. And... yes, it looks like you are well within our 90-day return window for standard apparel.
Oh, 90 days? That's a relief! So I can still send it back?

Absolutely. Since you just need a different size, I can process an exchange for you right now. I've gone ahead and initiated that and sent a pre-paid return label to your email on file. Your new, larger jersey will be sent out as soon as the original is scanned by the post office.
Wow, that was so easy. Thank you so much, Diana! I was so stressed about this.
You're very welcome. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
